# Three.js 0.170.0

Pinned, unmodified browser modules vendored for the static PVC workspace.
No network access or package installation is needed at runtime.

- `three.module.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js
- `OrbitControls.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
- `TransformControls.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/controls/TransformControls.js
- `LICENSE`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/LICENSE (MIT)

The page's import map resolves the controls' bare `three` import to this copy.
Update all three modules together when changing the pinned version.
